title: Checkride Mock-Oral Score Trend
dataSources: Flight logs (`flight:log`), flight-plan snapshots (`simbrief:plan`), network sessions (`vatsim:session`), prep tasks (`checkride:prep`), export syncs (`flight:export`).
app: Aviation and flight-sim telemetry — ForeFlight exports, SimBrief flight plans, VATSIM session logs, and checkride-prep trackers — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=checkride:prep subject=* mock_oral_score=*
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats avg(mock_oral_score) as metric by _time subject
| sort 0 _time subject
description: Trends monthly mock-oral score by checkride subject for checkride study blocks.
value: Monthly trend lines show whether checkride study blocks are improving, stalling, or becoming unbalanced over time.
implementation: Normalize `subject` on `checkride:prep` events and store the fields needed to calculate monthly mock-oral score.
visualization: Line chart of monthly mock-oral score by checkride subject.
grandmaExplanation: It frames how mock-oral score changes month by month for each checkride subject so you can see whether checkride study blocks are heading the right way.
